data.narrative:
Contec is a public-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Lee Sung-hee that has raised $58.7M to date. The valuation universe for Space & Aerospace comprises 13 comparables: 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Two standard triangulation methods cannot be applied to this analysis. Peer-median valuation failed due to insufficient granular peer overlap; while 14 same-sector peers exist in Space & Aerospace, filtering by stage, adjacent stage, and valuation tier yielded fewer than the required 3 datapoints in any single cohort. Public-comp anchoring is not feasible because Contec's revenue is not on file, preventing calculation against the sector median P/S multiple of 26.4x observed across the 6 public comps. Revenue disclosure remains sparse among private frontier-tech companies.

No triangulated valuation range can be supported by this dataset. A credible analysis would require either Contec's disclosed or estimated revenue, enabling P/S-based anchoring to public comparables, or identification of 3+ private peers at identical stage and similar valuation tier for median-multiple estimation. The key uncertainty is revenue scale; without it, even the broad sector P/S multiple of 26.4x cannot be operationalized.
